post.description: Returns the endpoint’s signing secret. Needs write access (`data:write`), like creating or rotating one, because the secret lets its holder sign webhooks.
Changes the URL, events or enabled flag, or rotates the signing secret. Fields left out keep their values. The response includes `secret` only when it was rotated.
Removes the endpoint. Deliveries still queued for it are not sent.
Sends a signed `webhook.test` event to the endpoint now. The result is only "delivered" or "failed", with the status code the endpoint answered or a generic error class.

Seal a temporary upload so it is kept. Public media is published to the public bucket. When the app has WebP on, JPEG and PNG images are converted to WebP first, and the response describes the WebP. Sealing media that is already sealed returns it unchanged.
